title: codexrig config
description: Configuration for codexrig (~/.codexrig/config.json): the sync remote, per-machine path maps, sync roots, and retention.

remote.description: The private git remote sync pushes to and pulls from. codexrig verifies it is private and refuses a public one.

machines.description: Per-machine path identities, keyed by machine name.

roots.description: Sync roots and their per-OS locations. codexrig ships one: "cli", Codex's home at $HOME/.codex.

location.description: Where the root lives, as portable templates resolved against a machine.

portable.description: A token-bearing path, identical on every OS (e.g. "$HOME/.codex").

retention.description: The rolling window for session rollouts, and the size limits that keep one runaway session from wedging a push.

historyDays.description: Drop rollouts older than this many days. 0 keeps everything.

squashFactor.description: Squash history when the git footprint exceeds this multiple of the retained tree.

floorBytes.description: NOT IMPLEMENTED YET — history squash is recorded here for forward compatibility and has no effect. Never squash below this size.

maxFileBytes.description: Drop any single file larger than this. 0 means the default (50 MB); negative means no cap.

largeFileBytes.description: Past this size a rollout is restaged only once it has grown by half as much again, or has gone quiet. 0 means the default (8 MB); negative restages every change.

squashKeepDays.description: NOT IMPLEMENTED YET — history squash is recorded here for forward compatibility and has no effect. Whole days of sync history an automatic squash leaves standing. 0 means the default (30).

syncSessions.description: Carry session rollouts as well as configuration. Off by default: a rollout is large, and cross-machine resume is not a proven round trip, so carrying it is backup rather than portability.

redactTranscripts.description: Scrub credential-shaped tokens out of the STAGED copy of a rollout. The live file in ~/.codex is never touched.

autoRestore.description: Let the session-start hook also restore onto a machine that has no Codex configuration yet. It never restores over an established machine.

alwaysPrune.description: Make `restore` remove skills, prompts and rules deleted on another machine, as if --prune were passed.

hookIntervalMinutes.description: How long a hook-driven sync waits before doing the work again. Absent means the default (5). 0 or negative means no wait at all. Codex's Stop hook fires at the end of every turn in every open session.

chunkRollouts.description: Store a rollout over 8 MiB in the repo as content-addressed 4 MiB parts plus an index, so an append costs a chunk rather than a copy. Absent follows what the repository already holds: parts if it has chunked rollouts, whole files if it has large plain ones, parts when there is nothing large yet to go on. A chunked rollout is also exempt from maxFileBytes, since no blob it produces approaches a host's object limit.
